+name: CI
+

+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        with:
+          distribution: temurin
+          java-version: '21'
+          cache: maven
+      - uses: grafana/setup-k6-action@v1
+      - name: Start Compose services

+      - name: Run smoke benchmark and invariants

+          OUTBOX_MODE: 'true'

+      - name: Stop Compose services
+        if: always()
+        run: docker compose --profile distributed down -v

index 0000000..0d2e8e9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docker-compose.prod.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,99 @@
+services:
+  postgres:
+    image: postgres:16-alpine
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    environment:
+      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:?POSTGRES_DB is required}
+      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:?POSTGRES_USER is required}
+      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_PASSWORD is required}
+    volumes:
+      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
+    healthcheck:
+      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $$POSTGRES_USER -d $$POSTGRES_DB"]
+      interval: 5s
+      timeout: 3s
+      retries: 30
+
+  redis:
+    image: redis:7-alpine
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    healthcheck:
+      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
+      interval: 5s
+      timeout: 3s
+      retries: 30
+
+  kafka:
+    image: apache/kafka:3.8.0
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    environment:
+      KAFKA_NODE_ID: 1
+      KAFKA_PROCESS_ROLES: broker,controller
+      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT
+      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://:9092,CONTROLLER://:9093
+      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092
+      KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_VOTERS: 1@kafka:9093
+      KAFKA_CONTROLLER_LISTENER_NAMES: CONTROLLER
+      KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT
+      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
+      KAFKA_TRANSACTION_STATE_LOG_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
+      KAFKA_TRANSACTION_STATE_LOG_MIN_ISR: 1
+      KAFKA_GROUP_INITIAL_REBALANCE_DELAY_MS: 0
+      KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS: 3
+      KAFKA_LOG_CLEANER_ENABLE: "false"
+      KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS: ${KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS:--Xms64m -Xmx128m}
+    volumes:
+      - kafka_data:/var/lib/kafka/data
+    healthcheck:
+      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --list >/dev/null 2>&1"]
+      interval: 5s
+      timeout: 5s
+      retries: 30
+
+  app:
+    build:
+      context: .
+      dockerfile: Dockerfile
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    environment:
+      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS: ${JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS:--Xmx256m}
+      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB}
+      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: ${POSTGRES_USER}
+      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
+      SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST: redis
+      SPRING_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS: kafka:9092
+    depends_on:
+      postgres:
+        condition: service_healthy
+      redis:
+        condition: service_healthy
+      kafka:
+        condition: service_healthy
+    healthcheck:
+      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "kill -0 1"]
+      interval: 10s
+      timeout: 3s
+      retries: 12
+      start_period: 30s
+
+  nginx:
+    build:
+      context: .
+      dockerfile: frontend/Dockerfile
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    ports:
+      - "80:80"
+    volumes:
+      - ./deploy/nginx.prod.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
+    depends_on:
+      app:
+        condition: service_healthy
+    healthcheck:
+      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://127.0.0.1/"]
+      interval: 10s
+      timeout: 3s
+      retries: 12
+
+volumes:
+  postgres_data:
+  kafka_data:

+persistence mutually exclusive while decision state remains intact. Executed
+reproduction, follow-up trials, latency costs and remaining limitations are in
+[bench/REPORT.md](bench/REPORT.md) and [RESULTS.md](RESULTS.md).
 
 ## What it does
 
 1. Operator initializes Redis stock key for a product ID.

+

+# Refund/persistence race: executed evidence
+
+All measurements below come from local executed runs. k6, nginx, both app replicas, Redis, RabbitMQ and PostgreSQL shared one laptop. No parallel load campaigns, builds or tests ran during measured load. Host-side report preparation and saved-snapshot audits did run during parts of the fault campaigns; that local tooling noise is retained. The normal-ramp comparison was not overlapped with those full snapshot scans. Docker snapshots are sampled observations, not guaranteed peaks. No runs were removed for threshold failures or noise.
+
+**Negative availability finding:** fixed broker-restart runs still failed HTTP requests. The largest measured HTTP error fraction was `0.3659522769984244` in `rabbit-6`; that run is retained, not dismissed as noise. Inventory arbitration does not fix broker-outage HTTP availability.
+

The normal baseline source matches that HEAD; its later runs record a bench-only commit. All baseline containers used the same app image, checked below.
